canonical_target_opposing_implementation: The older indexed native linker matched specNumber without a release guard. Add a new Abnormal Conditions: when NG-RAN node2 receives the Future Coverage Modification List IE and includes cells and beams for which the Predicted Coverage Modification Cause IE is set to "cancel", in case the list of cells and beams associated with the "cancel" codepoint is not the same as the list of cells and beams in a previously received Future Coverage Modification List IE, the NG-RAN node2 shall ignore the list of cells and beam associated with the "cancel" codepoint in the received IE.

This CR has isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release), because it only affects the AI/ML-based CCO feature..
